title: FreezeCommand
body:
Freeze – The Ultimate Player Freezing Plugin! ❄️

With Freeze, you can freeze players directly via chat commands, preventing them from moving, interacting with blocks, or attacking until they are unfrozen. Perfect for staff, moderators, and admins who want full control over the server!

Key Features:
Blocks movement, block placement/breaking, and interactions.

Built-in permission control: only players with freezeplugin.freeze can use the commands.

Supports groups and custom permissions for moderators and staff.

⚡ Compatible with Minecraft 1.13 to 1.21+ (partial backwards compatibility to 1.8).
Why Use It?
Keep order on your server during events, roleplay, or to stop griefers.

Manage troublesome players without kicking them.

Lightweight, easy to configure, and ready to use.
